ShipLogDictionary.GITM_GHOST_CURIOSITY_INITIAL: Hello? Can anyone hear me? It's dark and scary here. I can't see anything, not even with my third eye.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_GHOST_HELLO_FOLLOWUP: I do not know, help me
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_GHOST_HELLO_FOLLOWUP_REVEAL: I don't know, my memories are all jumbled! I am a Nomai, I think. But I can read your words. Can you help me? I think I am trapped somewhere.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_CHOICE_PLACES_REVEAL: I need more to go on than that. Do you remember where you were before you got trapped? Any important locations or landmarks?
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_GHOST_CLASSROOM_HINT_REVEAL: I remember being in a school. I loved giving presentations. If you find the classroom, maybe it will help me remember more.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_WALL_TOOL_UNLOCK: I remember how to use the staff now! I haven't mastered it or anything, but they did teach me how to use the preset functionality to create whiteboards from existing stone. Maybe you can do it, too?
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_DOOR_TOOL_UNLOCK: The doors! I remember being late to class because one of the orbs had fallen off its door, and I had to go all the way around. The staff can reach the controls from either side, though. Try it on a door and see!
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_BEAM_TOOL_UNLOCK: A tractor beam with no switch on it? There might be a mechanism somewhere else that controls it, but the staff can override it in an emergency. Does this qualify?

ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_0_REVEAL: I got the launch codes from Hornfels, and picked up the translator tool prototype from Hal! They were really excited about this new statue Gabbro found. Maybe I'll learn more about it today on my first ever space adventure!
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_1_REVEAL: I had some trouble avoiding the trees on my way off planet, so I stopped by the Attlerock to say hi to Esker! Well, mostly to repair the ship, but also to say hi to Esker!
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_2_REVEAL: I made it to the Hourglass Twins! My ship just got caught in the sand column, though, so I guess I'll just explore Ember Twin for now and figure out how to get back to the ship later.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_3_REVEAL: Woah! I stepped into one of the towers on Ash Twin while the sand passed by and found myself inside some kind of big Nomai contraption! I'm not sure what it does, but it makes funny noises when I poke it with this staff I found.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_4_REVEAL: I tried walking into a different tower, and it warped me somewhere else! I think this is Brittle Hollow, based on the pictures I've seen. My ship ended up here somehow too, but I'm afraid to jump down to reach it. I'm not immortal, after all.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_5_REVEAL: I feel like there's something else I can be doing here, but for now I'm just feeling stuck, up here on the ceiling. Maybe I'll go back and try somewhere else.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_6_REVEAL: I made it to Giant's Deep! I tried putting my little scout on the platform to see what would happen, but it got warped away without me, and now I can't go back. Guess my ship is gone for good, then. Sorry, Slate. Maybe I can find Gabbro and ask for a ride later.
ShipLogDictionary.GITM_PLAYER_STEP_7_REVEAL: This island has more weird Nomai statues! These ones look angry, too. I'm tempted to poke them with my staff again...

DialogueDictionary.GITM_MASK_COMPUTER_1: <TimeMinutes> MINUTES, <TimeSeconds> SECONDS AGO: Received data from previous cycles. <color=red>ERROR! System overloaded. Cycle duration was shorter than expected.</color>
DialogueDictionary.GITM_MASK_COMPUTER_2:
MASKS RECEIVING DATA FROM:
<ActiveStatueList><color=red>ERROR! System overloaded. Data streams may overlap each other unexpectedly.</color>
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_IDENTIFY_1: This mask appears to contain the memories of my friend, Lami! This is quite the surprise.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_IDENTIFY_2: She came to see me before I left <color=lightblue>Brittle Hollow</color> to make my pilgrimage here to the <color=lightblue>Quantum Moon</color>. These memories appear to be much older, though, from when she lived on <color=lightblue>Giant's Deep</color>.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_EXPLAIN_1: The data uplink functionality of this mask appears to be broken. It is not paired to a statue, but is still transmitting data, which the system was not designed to handle. The memory data will be leaking into other systems not intended to interpret that data.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_EXPLAIN_2: This is not my area of study, but I suggest taking it to the <color=orange>Ash Twin Project</color>. The central computer there should be capable of correcting the error automatically.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_EYE_1: The greatest minds of our clan designed these masks for the <color=orange>Ash Twin Project</color> in the hopes of finding the <color=lightblue>Eye of the Universe</color>.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_EYE_2: I heard that the project failed, but perhaps someone else will be able to use the systems they designed to succeed where we did not.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_QUANTUM_MOON_1: Thank you for bringing Lami's memories here, to the <color=lightblue>Quantum Moon</color>. That must have been a difficult journey.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_YOU_1: Lami and I are at different stages of adolescence, but we are close friends nontheless! I recall playing with her near the anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin frequently.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_YOU_2: I have always admired her academic accomplishments. The teachers would even use her presentations as examples for the younger children.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_ME_1: From what I can read of her memories here, it appears that you have been helping this fragment of Lami for some time now. The living Lami would be just as grateful, I'm sure of it.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_THE_NOMAI_1: The lead scientists behind the <color=orange>Ash Twin Project</color> were all paired to statues and masks like this one during their attempt to activate it. I wonder if their memory fragments could also experience this issue.

DialogueDictionary.GITM_SOLANUM_THE_NOMAI_2: This mask appears to be an earlier prototype, so I do not know how its functionality might differ from theirs.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_1: Hey it's me Ernesto the ghostly talking anglerfish.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_2: Also you just turned your statue off. You know that, right?
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_3: That's the one that sends your memories back at the start of every loop. Kind of a big deal.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_4: So now nobody remembers anything, nobody fixes anything, and the sun just keeps blowing up forever. Real bleak.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_5: The other statues are fine to turn off. That's part of the puzzle here even. But yours is actually important and stuff.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_6: Geswaldo bet me you'd do it eventually. So thanks for that, I guess.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_FIRST_7: Anyway. Want me to put it back?
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_OPTION_REFUSE: Nope. I meant to do that.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_UNDO_2: There you go. Weird glowy eyes back on. Try not to do it again, it's a whole thing.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_REFUSE_2: Well, it's your loop, pal. I just work here. Well, actually, I don't. But you know what I mean.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_REFUSE_3: Anyway, don't act surprised when the credits roll. I did warn you.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_SECOND_1: Hey it's me Ernesto the ghostly talking anglerfish. Again.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_SECOND_2: We just did this literally a minute ago. I said words. A lot of them were 'don't'.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_SECOND_3: Do you want it back on or not.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_UNDO_AGAIN_1: Fine. Last time. I'm serious. I have better things to be doing.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_UNDO_AGAIN_2: I see you giggling. 'Ooh, he's going to keep going, I should turn it off a third time.' Seriously. I'm warning you. Stop.
DialogueDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_REFUSE_AGAIN_2: I'm going to go find a rock.

UIDictionary.TerribleFateGameOver:
With your statue deactivated, your control over fate is forfeit.
The universe remains in stasis for all eternity, unable to live, unable to die.
UIDictionary.GITM_ERNESTO_GAME_OVER:
Ernesto beat you to death with a rock.
He did warn you.
UIDictionary.GITM_ADDON_POPUP: Ghost in the Machine is intended to be played standalone. Please disable other story mods before playing it, if any are enabled.
